verdict.rationale: Amending or undoing commits is a fair question for a mobile GitHub/code client, since dedicated mobile git clients exist. Nothing in the evidence shows GitHub Mobile can amend the latest commit, undo unpushed commits, or rewrite local history. Its documentation covers PR review, merging, code search and Copilot agent tasks, and community feedback describes it as not really a git client.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can amend the latest commit or undo unpushed commits to fix or split them
